# BLACKLISTED

> BLACKLISTED is a streetwear clothing store in Nizamabad, Telangana, India, run by Trend Maker (Instagram: @trend______maker). Tagline: "Not just for everyone." Store Instagram: @blacklisted_store1.

## What it sells
- Shirts, t-shirts, baggy jeans, accessories and jewellery.

## Pages
- [Home](https://blacklisted-trendmaker.vercel.app/): a walk into the store, the product categories, and how to visit.
- [Privacy](https://blacklisted-trendmaker.vercel.app/privacy)
